set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
# R needs a writable TMPDIR/HOME or it dies with "cannot create R_TempDir"
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp

cat > edger.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressMessages(library(edgeR))
counts <- as.matrix(read.delim("counts.tsv", row.names=1, check.names=FALSE))
grp <- factor(rep(c("ctrl","trt"), each=ncol(counts)/2))
y <- DGEList(counts, group=grp); y <- calcNormFactors(y)
d <- model.matrix(~grp); y <- estimateDisp(y, d)
tt <- topTags(glmQLFTest(glmQLFit(y, d), coef=2), n=Inf)$table
out <- data.frame(gene=rownames(tt), lfc=tt$logFC, padj=tt$FDR)
write.table(out, "res_edger.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
tr <- read.delim("truth.tsv"); sig <- subset(out, padj < 0.05)
cat("edgeR significant:", nrow(sig), " recovered planted:", sum(tr$gene %in% sig$gene), "of", nrow(tr), "\n")
RSCRIPT
Rscript edger.R
cat > cmp.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressMessages({library(limma); library(edgeR)})
counts <- as.matrix(read.delim("counts.tsv", row.names=1, check.names=FALSE))
grp <- factor(rep(c("ctrl","trt"), each=ncol(counts)/2))
d <- model.matrix(~grp)
v <- voom(calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts, group=grp)), d)
tt <- topTable(eBayes(lmFit(v, d)), coef=2, number=Inf)
out <- data.frame(gene=rownames(tt), lfc=tt$logFC, padj=tt$adj.P.Val)
write.table(out, "res_limma.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)

tr <- read.delim("truth.tsv")
R <- list(deseq2=read.delim("res_deseq2.tsv"), edger=read.delim("res_edger.tsv"), limma=out)
sig <- lapply(R, function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x$padj),]; x$gene[x$padj < 0.05] })
rec <- sapply(sig, function(s) sum(tr$gene %in% s))
cat("=== recovery of", nrow(tr), "planted genes ===\n"); print(rec)
cat("=== total significant ===\n"); print(sapply(sig, length))

# EXACT check 1: planted direction must be recovered by every method
dirok <- sapply(names(R), function(m) {
  x <- R[[m]]; mm <- merge(tr, x, by="gene")
  sum(sign(mm$lfc) == sign(mm$dir))
})
cat("=== planted genes with CORRECT direction (of", nrow(tr), ") ===\n"); print(dirok)

# EXACT check 2: on genes all three call significant, all three must agree on sign
common <- Reduce(intersect, sig)
lf <- Reduce(function(a,b) merge(a,b,by="gene"),
             lapply(names(R), function(m) setNames(R[[m]][,c("gene","lfc")], c("gene", m))))
lfc <- lf[lf$gene %in% common, ]
agree <- sum(sign(lfc$deseq2)==sign(lfc$edger) & sign(lfc$edger)==sign(lfc$limma))
cat("=== triple-significant genes:", length(common), " sign-agreement:", agree, "\n")

# BAND: rank concordance (different models => rank, not raw)
sp <- c(de_ed=cor(lf$deseq2, lf$edger, method="spearman"),
        de_li=cor(lf$deseq2, lf$limma, method="spearman"),
        ed_li=cor(lf$edger, lf$limma, method="spearman"))
cat("=== Spearman on log2FC, all", nrow(lf), "genes ===\n"); print(round(sp,4))

# ---- assertions: two exact, two justified bands ----
stopifnot(all(dirok == nrow(tr)))                 # EXACT: every planted direction recovered, all methods
stopifnot(agree == length(common))                # EXACT: sign agreement on triple-significant genes
stopifnot(all(rec >= 195))                        # band: strong planted effect must be recovered at high power
stopifnot(all(sp >= 0.95))                        # band: rank concordance (different models => rank, not raw)
lines <- c("RNA-seq differential expression -- three methods, one synthetic matrix with planted truth",
  sprintf("planted_genes        %d of %d at |log2FC| = 2", nrow(tr), nrow(R$deseq2)),
  sprintf("recovery             deseq2=%d edger=%d limma=%d  (assert >= 195)", rec[1], rec[2], rec[3]),
  sprintf("total_significant    deseq2=%d edger=%d limma=%d", length(sig$deseq2), length(sig$edger), length(sig$limma)),
  sprintf("planted_direction    deseq2=%d edger=%d limma=%d of %d  (assert == %d, EXACT)", dirok[1], dirok[2], dirok[3], nrow(tr), nrow(tr)),
  sprintf("triple_significant   %d   sign_agreement %d  (assert equal, EXACT)", length(common), agree),
  sprintf("spearman_log2fc      de-ed=%.4f de-li=%.4f ed-li=%.4f  (assert >= 0.95)", sp[1], sp[2], sp[3]),
  "note  limma-voom runs in the edgeR image because voom requires edgeR; a real dependency, not a shortcut")
writeLines(lines, "smoke-check.txt"); cat(paste(lines, collapse="\n"), "\n")
cat("SMOKE CHECK PASSED\n")
RSCRIPT
Rscript cmp.R
